company.name: Airborne
company.shortDescription: Mobile App developer focused on creating tools to assist people with disabilities.
company.description:
We improve the life of people with disabilities through the profound understanding of spaces and the creation of tools that allow them to navigate through them. Our mobile app is designed to specifically tailor different disabilities and guide users in the best and fastest way through our customer's spaces.

We can assess and guide our customers on the best ways to create accessible spaces. Using the latest technology for indoor navigation through BLE transceivers and implementing Augmented Reality (AR) tools we make sure to deliver effective and on time information to assist our users, making sure that they engage more and resonate with our customer's businesses. Our services are designed for different spaces from office layouts to airports and large events venues.
